abstract: A 23-year-old man complaining of right-sided chest pain was admitted to our hospital for further examination of an abnormal shadow on chest X-ray films. Initially, we suspected the abnormal shadow was that of a pleural effusion in the right thorax. Computed tomographic scans disclosed a tumor in the anterior mediastinum, adjacent to the abnormal shadow. After closer examination, particularly by fluoroscopy on catheterization, we recognized that the abnormal shadow was a giant cyst, and that it connected with a solid mass. There were no abnormal laboratory data on admission. An examination of fluid specimens from the giant cyst revealed high levels of the tumor markers SCC antigen, CEA, and CA 19-9. These findings together suggested that the solid mass with giant cyst might be a mediastinal teratoma. The tumor was completely resectable without serious complications. The giant cyst contained 1,200 ml of fluid, and occupied half the volume of the right thoracic cavity. Pathological examination disclosed that the resected mediastinal tumor was a matured teratoma. Although matured teratoma are often composed of cysts, those that radiologically resemble pleural effusion, as in this case, were considered uncommon.
abstract_ja: 23歳男性が右胸部痛を主訴に入院した。胸部X線写真で異常陰影を認め、当初は右胸腔内の胸水と考えた。CTで前縦隔に腫瘍が認められ、その異常陰影に隣接していた。カテーテル検査時の透視を含めて詳細に検討したところ、異常陰影は充実性腫瘤と連続する巨大嚢胞であった。入院時の検査値に異常はなかった。巨大嚢胞の液体検体では、腫瘍マーカーであるSCC抗原、CEA、CA19-9が高値であった。これらの所見から、充実性腫瘤を伴う巨大嚢胞は縦隔奇形腫である可能性が示唆された。腫瘍は合併症なく完全切除可能であった。巨大嚢胞には1,200 mlの液体が貯留しており、右胸腔の半分を占めていた。病理学的検査で切除された縦隔腫瘍は成熟奇形腫と判明した。成熟奇形腫はしばしば嚢胞で構成されるが、本症例のように単純X線で胸水に類似するものは稀であると考えられた。
